definitions.explanation: Outdoor leisure activities such as camping, hiking, and fishing. Also used as a modifier to describe products or lifestyles oriented toward outdoor recreation.

examples.japanese: アウトドア⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧アウトドア⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: I often enjoy outdoor activities on weekends.

examples.japanese: アウトドア{用品|ようひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揃|そろ}えて→揃える：01952_soroeru⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦キャンプ→キャンプ：03837_kyanpu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: We plan to get outdoor gear together and go camping as a family.

notes:
アウトドア comes from English "outdoor" and refers to outdoor recreational activities like camping, hiking, and fishing. It is used both as a standalone noun and as a modifier.

USAGE:
- As a noun: アウトドア⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧ (I like outdoor activities)
- As a modifier: アウトドア{用品|ようひん} (outdoor gear)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- アウトドア{用品|ようひん}: outdoor gear/equipment
- アウトドア⟦{派|は}→派：28356_ha⟧: outdoor type (person who prefers outdoor activities)
- アウトドア⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧: outdoor activities
- アウトドア⟦ブランド→ブランド：05221_burando⟧: outdoor brand
- アウトドアライフ: outdoor lifestyle

SIMILAR WORDS:
- インドア: indoor activities/type — アウトドア⟦{派|は}→派：28356_ha⟧ vs. インドア⟦{派|は}→派：28356_ha⟧ is a common way to describe lifestyle preferences
